instrument: xml `calls` 138 — the violation worklist for the shared-resolver fix
runLabel: ONE RUN, ONE INDEX. Population: 2,000 files drawn / 1,995 indexed from libxslt, dbeaver, phpunit, Fabulous. Bounded draw, not the 11,562-file population (the full attempt was KILLED on event-loop stalls — see store-intent-split-full-attempt-KILLED.txt).
whyTheseAreViolations: Every one is class `in-document` — the analyzer STATES the callee is declared in the edge's own document — and the store bound it to a declaration in ANOTHER file. Not an ambiguity and not an unresolved edge: a wrong binding.
shape: Every calls violation is a CALLER in one directory bound to a same-named TEMPLATE declared in the PARALLEL directory — libxslt/tests/docbook/html/*.xsl against libxslt/tests/docbook/fo/*.xsl — plus a few bound into test data files. The own-file declaration exists in every case and is listed per edge.
